page_title: WAL 0-2 IRN | Wales v Iran 25/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+11' 0 - 2 GOAL! Ramin Rezaeian (Iran) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Danny Ward, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:2.

90+8' 0 - 1 Roozbeh Cheshmi (Iran) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.
90+7' Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+5' Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) will miss the next game.
90+5' The foul by Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mario Escobar.
90+5' Ramin Rezaeian (Iran) argues with the referee and is booked for dissent.
90+4' Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wales.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' Mehdi Torabi (Iran) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wales will have a goal kick.
87' Forced substitution due to red card. Danny Ward joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aaron Ramsey (Wales).
86' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Wayne Hennessey (Wales). He’s got to go!

86' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Wayne Hennessey (Wales), but referee Mario Escobar must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
85' Wayne Hennessey (Wales) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
84' Wales take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

84' Ben Davies (Wales) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Hossein Hosseini pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Now Wales have a corner.
83' Carlos Queiroz decides to make a substitution. Saeid Ezatolahi will be replaced by Ali Karimi (Iran).
81' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
77' The substitution is prepared. Roozbeh Cheshmi (Iran) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ahmad Noorollahi.
77' Substitution. Ethan Ampadu leaves the pitch and is replaced by Joe Allen (Wales).
77' Carlos Queiroz has decided to substitute Ali Gholizadeh and he is replaced by Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran).
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ehsan Hajsafi as he is replaced by Mehdi Torabi (Iran).
74' Ali Gholizadeh (Iran) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

74' Ehsan Hajsafi (Iran) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Iran manage to earn a corner.
74' Iran take a short corner kick.

73' Saeid Ezatolahi (Iran) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wayne Hennessey makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner. The ball is out of play. Iran will have a chance to score from a corner.
72' Iran work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' A cross into the box from Ali Gholizadeh (Iran) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Iran.

72' Morteza Pouraliganji (Iran) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Wayne Hennessey, who pulls off a comfortable save!
71' A cross from a corner kick by Iran is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

71' Ahmad Noorollahi (Iran) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Iran force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
68' The substitution has been made. Karim Ansarifard (Iran) has replaced Sardar Azmoun.
65' Iran have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Wow, what an escape. Mehdi Taremi (Iran) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Iran earn a corner.
63' Ali Gholizadeh (Iran) launches a cross from the corner, but Wayne Hennessey is alert to thwart the effort.
63' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Iran are awarded a corner kick.

61' The cross into the penalty area from Ethan Ampadu (Wales) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Iran.
61' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
58' Looks like Sardar Azmoun (Iran) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
57' Robert Page prepares a substitution. Harry Wilson is replaced by Daniel James (Wales).
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Brennan Johnson (Wales) is replacing Connor Roberts.
57' Ehsan Hajsafi (Iran) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
56' Ehsan Hajsafi (Iran) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

53' Kieffer Moore (Wales) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Kieffer Moore (Wales) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Iran.

52' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Wayne Hennessey, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
52' Ali Gholizadeh (Iran) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the left post!

52' OFF THE POST! Sardar Azmoun (Iran) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
50' Kieffer Moore (Wales) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
48' Ramin Rezaeian (Iran) sends a long ball in, but Wayne Hennessey comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Referee Mario Escobar blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45+3' Mario Escobar shows a yellow card to Joe Rodon (Wales) for a tough tackle.
45+2' Ahmad Noorollahi (Iran) attempts to find Sardar Azmoun, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wales.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Ali Gholizadeh (Iran) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wales.
42' A corner kick by Wales is thwarted by the well prepared Hossein Hosseini (Iran).
42' A pass lands at the feet of Harry Wilson (Wales) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Good work from Wales as they win a corner.
39' Neco Williams (Wales) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
36' Neco Williams (Wales) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Iran will have a goal kick.
33' Ehsan Hajsafi (Iran) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.

29' Gareth Bale (Wales) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed low towards the middle of the goal, but Hossein Hosseini reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
28' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) is able to continue to play.
27' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

23' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the left-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Wales will have a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Wales will have a goal kick.
23' Ethan Ampadu (Wales) commits a rough foul. Mario Escobar stops the game and makes a call. Iran are awarded the free kick.
20' Ahmad Noorollahi (Iran) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
17' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Iran due to an offside in the build-up play.
17' The Iran players halt their celebrations as referee Mario Escobar makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
16' Ali Gholizadeh (Iran) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the left side of the goal.
14' Kieffer Moore (Wales) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
13' Kieffer Moore (Wales) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

12' Kieffer Moore (Wales) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
10' Aaron Ramsey (Wales) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
7' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Wayne Hennessey is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ali Gholizadeh (Iran).

3' Harry Wilson (Wales) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Iran.
2' A crossfield pass from Ali Gholizadeh (Iran) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Wales will have a goal kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Wales will take the kick-off.
Mario Escobar got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
